patches.title: Reject RAR5 filter blocks larger than half the decoder window
patches.description: Rejects an oversized filter block before decoding can enter a state without forward progress.

dep3.origin: Backport of the upstream RAR5 filter-block size check.

referenceFiles.purpose: Upstream-style regression test source retained as review context; the installed-package test uses the encoded archive below with the platform's bounded archive probe.

tests.baselineExpectation: The vulnerable focal archive probe times out on the bounded RAR5 fixture.
tests.patchedExpectation: The installed focal backport rejects the fixture within the five-second limit; normal bsdtar create/extract checks pass.

patches.title: Avoid signed overflow in encrypted ZIP size calculations
patches.description: Avoid adding encryption overhead before the Zip64 size comparison, and reject encrypted stored sizes that cannot safely include their overhead.

dep3.origin: Trixie-compatible backport of the upstream encrypted ZIP size overflow fix; uses a direct INT64_MAX guard because this source version does not contain archive_ckd_add_i64.

referenceFiles.purpose: Installed-package ZIP header compatibility check; exact-source UBSan checks use the same AES-256 INT64_MAX fixture to prove the baseline overflow and patched behavior.

tests.baselineExpectation: The exact Debian source build reports signed overflow for INT64_MAX + 28 under UBSan; the installed Trixie library completes the header operation within the five-second bound.
tests.patchedExpectation: The patched exact-source UBSan build completes without signed overflow, and the installed backport completes the header operation within the five-second bound.

patches.title: Allow two-byte Zstandard output variation in a tiny-input test
patches.description: The Ubuntu Focal zstd implementation emits 746 bytes at compression level 6 versus 744 bytes at the default level for this small test payload. Allow only that two-byte variation and continue the archive readback checks.

dep3.origin: GetPatched test-only portability adjustment; no runtime code is changed.

tests.expectation: The two-byte compression-size difference is reported as skipped; the test continues through archive readback assertions.
